title: Genome wide CRISPR/Cas9 screen identifies the coagulation factor IX (F9) as a regulator of senescence
model: MCF7 breast cancer cells, genome-wide GeCKO knockout library, palbociclib (CDK4/6 inhibitor)
paper_method: Fold change of transformed RPKM (>2-fold in >=3 guides)
paper_calls: 18 genes enriched; F9 and PROZ validated
barcs_calls: 100 genes at FDR 0.10 (42 enriched); counts recovered from a transformed RPKM table
verdict: BARCS does not support F9 or PROZ: each has a few guides rising under palbociclib while its most abundant guides fall, which a fold-change rule over 3 guides picks up but a model of all guides and replicates does not.
